reason: My customers buy from me because they know me, they shake my hand at the fair and they call my mobile. I might take the free list of 15 companies to see what they find, but I would not pay EUR 350 a meeting for cold emails from some domain that is not even mine.
objection: A meeting set up by strangers is not a relationship. In wholesale a buyer who agrees to a call with an agency is just curious, and for EUR 350 a meeting I could pay half a junior SDR's monthly salary and keep the contacts in my own house.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesaler or distributor like me, someone I can call, telling me that those meetings turned into real orders, not just calls.
